name: JellySwipe
description: Pick libraries and genres, open a lobby (4-digit code + QR), and everyone swipes on their phone. The first titles everyone swiped right on win, and JellySwipe can start the winner on any Jellyfin device. Guests don't need a Jellyfin account.
overview: Tinder-style swiping over your library until everyone matches
changelog: First release: lobbies with code + QR, Tinder-style swiping, matches, solo mode, play/auto-play on Jellyfin devices, sidebar entry via File Transformation.
